pinewood.name: Misty Pinewood
pinewood.sub: The trees are leaning away from something

objects.label: sign
objects.text: North: Troll Hollow. Mind the creek.

objects.label: lore
objects.text: The Wardens planted the first pines to hold the Gloam back. Now the roots are black.

pinewood.objective: Follow the dirt road north. The animals are fleeing.

actions.text: Pip: The animals are running. Something big has woken in the pinewood.
Checkpoint: Glade of Arrival
Tablet: The Wardens planted the first pines to hold the Gloam back. Now the roots are black.

actions.title: Ogres!
actions.sub: Lesser brutes guard the sunlit clearing

actions.text: Heavy footsteps echo to the north...
Treasure gleams nearby...
Follow the road north to the stone plaza

triggers.name: Ogres and trolls at the plaza
Ogres and trolls at the plaza cleared

actions.text: The way to the hollow is clear.
Treasure gleams nearby...
Enter Troll Hollow (north-east)

actions.title: Troll Hollow
actions.sub: A shaman chants in the dark

actions.text: The shaman falls silent.
Treasure gleams nearby...
Take the rift down into the Root Hollow (key from the elite troll)

actions.title: Mountain Troll
actions.sub: Guardian of the Root Hollow key

actions.text: The troll drops a gnarled root key.
Treasure gleams nearby...
Pip: That key smells of roots and earth. It must open the Root Hollow below Troll Hollow.
Pip: The wall hums, Aerin. Something is hidden behind it.
A hidden gem cache!
Treasure gleams nearby...
A Socket Rune glints in the moss.
Treasure gleams nearby...
Pip: The water here ripples with dream-fish, Aerin. A secret pool!
Pip: The bridge is raised. There must be a lever somewhere.
A lever clunks. Far away, a bridge lowers.
A gold chest!
Treasure gleams nearby...

pinewood_boss.name: Bramblehorn's Court
pinewood_boss.sub: Where the old troll king holds his root-throne

actions.text: Pip: Aerin... the ground is shaking. That is the troll king.
Checkpoint: Bramblehorn's Court

actions.title: Old Bramblehorn
actions.sub: The Troll King - Shard of Root

actions.text: Defeat Old Bramblehorn

actions.title: Victory
actions.sub: The Shard of Root is relit

actions.text: Old Bramblehorn: I only wished to keep the roots from rotting... Morrow is no king. He is a sleeper who will not wake.
Treasure gleams nearby...
The Shard of Root: The Shard of Root is relit.
Take the rift to the Gloomspire Ruins, or return home

vale.name: Whispering Vale
vale.sub: A dream drifting above the clouds

objects.label: sign
objects.text: Training yard east. Elder Stone north-east.

objects.label: lore
objects.text: Aerin's lantern burns low. Wake the Shards and the Vale will bloom again.

vale.objective: Explore. Rifts hum to the north-east and the south.

actions.text: Pip: You are awake! I am Pip, your lantern spirit. Hit a training dummy with your blade to warm up.
Checkpoint: Whispering Vale
Treasure gleams nearby...
Pip: A weapon and a gem! Press I to open your bag and equip them.
Elder Stone: Dreamwarden... the Gloam seeps from the Unwaking King. Relight the four Dawn Shards. The rift south leads to the Misty Pinewood.
The Shard of Root: Enter the Misty Pinewood and defeat Old Bramblehorn.
A hidden gem cache!
Treasure gleams nearby...

roothollow.name: Root Hollow
roothollow.sub: Where the old roots drink the dark

objects.label: lore
objects.text: The first Warden sealed the Thornmother here to keep the Gloam from the pines.

roothollow.objective: Open the root door and descend.

actions.text: Pip: Roots everywhere... they are moving. Stay close to me.
A door of knotted roots. It needs the Root Hollow key.
Checkpoint: Root Hollow midpoint
The roots go still.
Treasure gleams nearby...
Rest at the shrine, then press on
Silence. A lever waits nearby.
Treasure gleams nearby...
Find the lever that raises the gate
The lever grinds. A gate rumbles open.
Descend to the Thornmother's den

actions.title: The Thornmother
actions.sub: Rootbound mother of the pines - mini-boss

actions.text: Defeat The Thornmother
The Thornmother: The roots remember the first Warden... he did not wake, and neither shall I.
Treasure gleams nearby...
Take the rift down to Old Bramblehorn
A second lever: the shortcut to the shrine is open.
Pip: The wall hums, Aerin. Something is hidden behind it.
A Socket Rune!
Treasure gleams nearby...
